description: This file defines the ClusterManifestProvider class, which manages the cluster's manifest, tracks membership updates, and provides mechanisms for updating and disseminating cluster state information within the Orleans runtime. It implements lifecycle participation, handles asynchronous updates, and interacts with other internal services to maintain cluster consistency.

classes.name: ClusterManifestProvider
classes.description: A class responsible for providing and updating the cluster manifest, managing membership changes, and integrating with the Orleans lifecycle.

methods.name: ClusterManifestProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with necessary services and setting up initial cluster state.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Asynchronous method that listens for membership updates and triggers manifest refreshes accordingly.

methods.name: UpdateManifest
methods.description: Updates the cluster manifest based on current membership snapshot, fetching missing manifests from other silos.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Begins the background task for processing membership updates.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes internal services such as the grain factory.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the membership processing task and performs cleanup.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the provider to the Orleans silo lifecycle events.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of resources, stopping background tasks.

methods.name: LogWarningErrorRetrievingSiloManifest
methods.description: Logs a warning when retrieving a silo's manifest fails.

methods.name: LogDebugStartingToProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Logs debug message indicating start of membership update processing.

methods.name: LogDebugStoppedProcessingMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Logs debug message indicating stop of membership update processing.
